acceptanceCriteria: A spec records the provider contract and qualification plan for at least one of the three ecosystems, with the others listed as deferred and reasoned.
body: Found by the 2026-10-20 read-only Beamfall setup review (corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 build 676; evidence under the session scratchpad beamfall-review/). Only Go and JS/TS have a live-test provider; Beamfall's Apple, Android and Windows repos have affected units and CEM runner profiles but nothing runs them live under Corvint.
title: Live-test providers for Swift (XCTest/Swift Testing), Gradle/JUnit and .NET (VSTest)
